mapping.note: HaN-Seg contours the carotid as one structure (common + internal). TotalSegmentator splits it: common carotid lives in `total`, internal carotid in `headneck_bones_vessels`. Scored against the union of the two.
HaN-Seg splits the globe into anterior (Eye_AL) and posterior (Eye_PL) segments; TotalSegmentator has one `eye_left`. Scored against the GT union.
Both label the optic nerve, but the posterior (intracranial / chiasmatic) cut-off is not standardised between the two conventions.
Same object, different cranio-caudal extent: HaN-Seg stops at the RT planning limits, TotalSegmentator labels the cord over the whole FOV. The z-restricted column is the boundary-accuracy number.

HaN-Seg `Esophagus_S` is the *cervical* oesophagus only (~1.5 mL, ~20 mm). TotalSegmentator `esophagus` runs the whole oesophagus in the FOV. The raw volume ratio is a protocol difference, not an error.
NOT the same object. HaN-Seg `Glottis` + `Larynx_SG` are laryngeal soft tissue; TotalSegmentator `larynx_air` is the air column inside the larynx. Reported only to document the size of the mismatch.

unmatched_gt.OAR_Arytenoid: no arytenoid class in any offered task (headneck_bones_vessels has thyroid/cricoid cartilage and hyoid only)
unmatched_gt.OAR_Brainstem: `total` has `brain` (whole brain) but no brainstem. The TotalSegmentator task that would carry it, `brain_structures`, needs a non-commercial licence key and is deliberately not offered.
unmatched_gt.OAR_Cavity_Oral: no counterpart (teeth / craniofacial tasks give jawbones, teeth and palate, not the oral cavity)
unmatched_gt.OAR_Cochlea_L: `auditory_canal_left` is the *external* auditory canal, not the cochlea
unmatched_gt.OAR_Glnd_Lacrimal_L: no lacrimal gland class in head_glands_cavities
unmatched_gt.OAR_Glnd_Lacrimal_R: no lacrimal gland class in head_glands_cavities

hnlnl: all 20 cervical nodal levels - HaN-Seg has no nodal-level ground truth
